Introduction.SourceString: 能倾听万物的「电波」的少女，简称为电波系少女。
Introduction.LocalizedString: A girl who can detect the "frequencies" of all things, perceiving the world like no one else.

Content.SourceString:
人类、异象、还有其它的万物，都有着某种唯一的、无法替代的实在感，或者说，一种「被感知」的趋势；就像挥舞色彩的群鸟，散布芳香的花卉，发出吟唱的鲸鱼……但在那之外，还有着某种更接近我们的本质、更独一无二的东西，正从我们的身心向外扩散，传播，跨越最致密的阻碍或最虚无的真空，向宇宙一刻不停地证明着我们的存在与唯一。
「就像是……频率不同的『电波』那样。」
在灵可登记异能情报时，几乎每位与她接触的记录员都会感到恍惚。少女的描述无法被任何仪器和理论证实，但他们却切实地感觉到，至少某个时刻，自己正在被倾听，被分享，如同在同一个频段里共振……直到对方用天真、关怀甚至带着些同情的嗓音，说出一些不该说的话，他们才赶紧重新拾起了作为大人的可靠面具。
「工作很辛苦呢……不可以逃掉吗？」
「咳、咳嗯！不可以。我也没有这么想。下一个问题——」

在异能觉醒之初，灵可经常因为同时接收过多的电波而陷入呆滞，甚至会无意识地将灌入脑中的噪波向外发送，干扰周围的设备和人们。异象管理局为她定做了一款头戴式设备，辅助她隔绝干扰、集中注意力。对多数同龄人而言，它的造型可能略显冷硬，但灵可非常喜欢。在觉醒异能之后，她对事物的喜好，以及喜欢、接触它们的原因，都变得更加令人费解，这也让她更加难以融入人群之中。但好在，对独来独往的灵可而言，「不被理解」从来不是什么需要解决的问题。
然而，一场意外为她带来了新的伙伴，一次勇敢为她赋予了新的职责。在与那位阴郁寡言的禁制机动队六队队长对峙之后，灵可被批准成为歧骸「小贞」的担保人，并破格收入了六队，成为其中年龄最小的成员。Exe的判断很准确，灵可的异能为六队抓捕涉异罪犯提供了极大的便利；也许是电波的引导，也许是宇宙的眷顾，她那奇妙的直觉和好运，也经常能在一些大型案件里成为破局的关键。但即便如此，哪怕她已经加入E.T.D一年，人们还是会为她那跳脱的行动思路捏一把汗。
「……那个，灵可，我们是不是离大部队太远了？」
「别担心，是大部队走丢了，相信我的直觉！」
Content.LocalizedString:
Humans, Anomalies, and everything else all possess a singular, universal truth—a drive to be perceived; like flocks of birds flashing their feathers, flowers giving off aromas, whales singing into the deep… But beyond that, there's something at our core, something even more uniquely our own, spreading outward from body and mind, crossing the thickest barriers and the deepest voids, ceaselessly proving our existence and uniqueness to the universe.
"Like… a 'frequency,' only tuned differently."
When Linko was having her Esper ability information registered, nearly everyone who dealt with her was left more confused than they started. Nothing the girl described could be verified by any device or theory, and yet they all stated at some point that they could clearly feel—if only for a moment—that they were being connected with, as if resonating on the same frequency as something else… Until Linko would say something she really shouldn't in that innocent, caring, faintly sympathetic voice of hers, and they would hurriedly put their dependable adult masks back on.
"Work's really rough, huh… Why not just jump ship?"
"Cough, cough! No, I can't. And I wasn't even thinking about such things. Next question—"

In the early days after her Esper ability awakened, Linko would often be left dizzy after syncing up with too many frequencies at once—causing her to send the noise flooding into her mind back out again unconsciously, disrupting nearby equipment and people. As a result, the Bureau custom-built a head-mounted device for her to help block out interference and to help her focus. Most people her age might have found its design a little intimidating, but Linko loved it. After her ability awakened, the things she liked—and the reasons she liked them or was drawn to them—only became harder for others to understand, which made it even harder for her to fit in. Fortunately, for a loner like Linko, "not being understood" was never a problem that needed solving.
And yet, one accident long ago introduced her to a new companion, and one act of courage landed her a new responsibility. After facing off against the gloomy, taciturn ETD-6 captain, Linko was approved to become the Guarantor for the Oddity Xiaozhen and was brought into ETD-6 as its youngest member due to a special exception. Exe's judgment was spot-on: Linko's Esper Ability made it far easier for ETD-6 to track down and capture Anomaly-related criminals. Whether it was truly frequencies guiding her, or merely the universe putting her on the right path, Linko's uncanny intuition was vital to cracking major cases regardless. Even so, even after a year in ETD, many people still can't help but worry about her wildly offbeat way of doing things.
"…Um, Linko, aren't we a little too far from the main group?"
"Don't worry. It's the main group that's lost. Trust my intuition!"

Content.SourceString:
「我的爸爸和妈妈都是异能者。」
灵可初次谈及家属的情况时，把管理局的档案管理员吓了一身冷汗，因为他们早就查过，她的父母只是非常普通……至少在海特洛，是没有异能的普通人。
但随后，当她说出「爸爸的异能是一动不动连看十几部电影」、「妈妈的异能是连逛十几条街不休息」后，诸位才狠狠松了一口气，转而开始八卦，这两个神奇的人是如何走到一起的。
灵可的母亲是一个城市探险博主，精力无穷的行动派，相信着幽灵、都市传说、ufo、外星人等等一切的可能性，每天都会在论坛上搜寻着有关的帖子，一旦觉得「可能是真的！」就会立刻出发寻找……当然，大多数时候，冒失的她都会被那些似是而非的帖子骗到，然后扑空，但她也从不因此气馁。最终，她终于闯进了一个并非编造的灵异地点……并掉进了异象空间之中，在那里，她遇到了另一个倒霉蛋：一个痴迷于灵异电影、苦于创作瓶颈，在闭门研究多日后、选在此地拍摄新作的倒霉摄影师。
于是，颇具海特洛风情的爱情故事发生了。两个性格完全不搭调的年轻人在异象空间里相遇，先是互相嫌弃，然后是相助，相伴，共同逃离险境，时常想起对方，最终，在下一次偶遇时向对方承认了心意——爸爸和妈妈的故事，灵可从双方的口中各听到过很多次，也有很多种互相冲突的版本，但唯一不变的是，他俩至今依然非常腻歪。
灵可降生后，这两位初为父母的海特洛年轻人向她灌注了所有的爱意，而灵可也继承了他们的特质。当女儿初次叼着奶嘴爬进卧室时，爸爸慷慨地分享了自己的珍藏——由他精心剪辑的健康版灵异电影……于是，灵可在还抱着奶瓶的年纪，就可以面不改色地与父亲一起鉴赏恐怖片；当女儿刚学会走路不久，妈妈会带着她出门练习，然后被街边没去过的店所吸引、不知不觉逛完整个街区……虽然听上去都是堪称离奇的经历，但每当灵可谈到自己的爸爸妈妈，她的脸上总会出现与他们相似的、幸福的笑容。
不管怎么说，小灵可在爱意的浇灌之中，长大了。
Content.LocalizedString:
"My mom and dad are both Espers."
The first time Linko talked about her family, she scared the Bureau's archivist half to death, because they'd already checked—her parents were perfectly normal—or at least, in Hethereau, normal people with no Esper abilities.
But then she further explained that her "Dad's Esper Ability is sitting perfectly still through more than a dozen movies in a row," and her "Mom's Esper Ability is walking more than a dozen street blocks without stopping," causing everyone to let out a sigh of relief. Afterwards, they immediately started gossiping about how such amazing people could've ended up together.
Linko's mother was an urban exploration blogger—an endlessly energetic go-getter who believed in ghosts, urban legends, UFOs, aliens, and just about every other paranormal thing you could think of. Every day she'd trawl forum posts for leads, and the moment she thought, "This might be a real one!" she'd set off to investigate… Of course, most of the time her impulsiveness got her fooled by those half-baked posts and she'd end up empty-handed, but she never let such things discourage her. Eventually, she really did stumble into a legitimate spooky spot… and subsequently fell into an Anomalous Realm. There, she met another unlucky soul: a film nerd obsessed with supernatural movies, stuck in a creative rut, who'd shut himself away for days to research new creative ideas before deciding on that spot to shoot his new project.
And so, a very Hethereau kind of love story began. Two young people whose personalities were complete opposites met in the Anomalous Realm. At first, they couldn't stand each other, but then later helped each other, stayed together, escaped danger alongside each other, kept thinking about each other, and finally, the next time they ran into each other, confessed their feelings. Linko has heard that story from them both many-a-time, along with plenty of conflicting versions—but the one thing that never changed was their continual adoration for each other.
After Linko was born, those two young Hethereau parents poured all their love into her, and thus she inherited their quirks, too. The first time their daughter crawled into the bedroom with a pacifier in her mouth, Dad generously shared one of his treasured finds—his carefully edited, age-appropriate supernatural movies… And just like that, before she had even outgrown her bottle, Linko could watch horror flicks with her father without batting an eye. Not long after she learned to walk, Mom would take her out to practice, only to get distracted by some shop she'd never been to before and somehow end up walking up and down the entire city block… Strange as all that sounds, whenever Linko talks about her mom and dad, she wears the same happy smile they do.
In any case, little Linko grew up bathed in love.

Content.SourceString:
灵可的异能觉醒于七岁。
那是一个再寻常不过的傍晚，妈妈带着灵可在超市中闲逛，顺便采买过节用的零食和装饰。灵可跟着语速和脚步逐渐加快的母亲，目光却因街边某个奇特的商铺而神游，当她回过神时，突然发现妈妈不见了，人群也不见了，就连所有的声音都消失了，身前身后都是空荡无人的商场。年幼的她并不理解什么是异象空间，她只想离开这个古怪的迷宫，找到妈妈。但那空间仿佛永无尽头，灵可用她细微地声音呼唤着，哭诉着，不知道该往哪里去，在数小时后，她疲惫地摔倒在地，几乎只有本能在心中祈求着……
「要是能回到爸爸妈妈身边就好了。」
仿佛是为了回应这个心愿，霎时间，自无限远的前方，无数嘈杂的「声音」如潮水般涌来，灌满了空荡荡的商场，最终如漩涡的一般压缩着钻进她的脑海……迷茫的，警惕的，疑惑的，担忧的，寂寞的，警笛，犬吠，歌声，喘息……还有妈妈。
年幼而疲惫的躯体在本能的驱使下重新站起，在万千无形的丝线之中，她循着最温暖、最熟悉那一条，缓缓走去。
近一点，再近一点。
那些「声音」变得越来越响，还有更多在涌入脑海，她已经无法思考，只是推着自己的脚步向前迈去——
灵可几乎想不起来自己到底是怎么走出来的了，只知道再睁开眼睛时，哭成泪人的爸爸妈妈将自己抱得很紧，旁边几个穿着制服的陌生人也松了口气。
灵可后来得知，当她被卷入异象空间后，异象管理局出动了收容组介入。但她不知道的是，搜救人员刚确认异象空间的出口，在场所有人都突然感觉自己听到了混乱的噪音，电子通讯设备一度瘫痪，部分人甚至声称看到了重叠的商场画面，或同时听到了来自多个方位的同一声音。这项意外严重影响了搜救工作，当局甚至怀疑是异能者从中作祟，已准备派遣E.T.D介入调查，但随后，灵可主动从异象空间出口走出，在听到母亲的一声呼唤后，立刻失神，影响众人的噪声干扰随之停息，而在场的异象管理局成员面面相觑。
「报告，受困市民已脱险，疑似为异能者，至于目标异象……已确认泯除。」
Content.LocalizedString:
Linko's Esper Abilities awakened at the young age of seven.
It was an utterly ordinary evening. Linko's mother had taken her along on a stroll through the supermarket, picking up holiday snacks and decorations while they were out. Linko followed her mother, yet her gaze drifted to a peculiar shop down the street. When she snapped back into reality, her mother had vanished entirely. The crowd was gone too, along with the surrounding noise, leaving her alone in an empty mall. At the time, she was too young to understand what an Anomalous Realm was. Initially, Linko had only wanted to escape that strange maze so that she could find her mother. The space itself was seemingly infinite, however. Linko called out in a faint little voice and cried, with no idea where to go. Hours later, exhausted, she fell to the floor, with almost nothing left but a plea on her lips…
"If only I could find Mom and Dad."
As if answering that wish, all at once, countless loud "voices" surged in from beyond, flooding the empty mall, then spiraling inward like a vortex and forcing their way into her mind: confused, wary, uncertain, worried, lonely, sirens, barking dogs, singing, ragged breathing… and her mother.
Driven by instinct, her young, exhausted body pushed itself back to its feet. Among the countless invisible threads of sounds, she followed the warmest, most familiar one and continued walking.
Farther. Just a little farther.
The "voices" grew louder and louder, and more and more noises poured into her mind. She could no longer think straight. She could only continue to walk—
Linko could barely remember how she escaped. She only knew that when she opened her eyes again, her tearful parents were holding her tight, and the unfamiliar people in uniforms nearby sighed in relief.
Linko later learned that after she was drawn into an Anomalous Realm, the Bureau dispatched the Containment Units to intervene and rescue her. What she didn't know was that as soon as search personnel confirmed the exit, everyone present suddenly felt as if they were hearing an imaginary, chaotic uproar. Electronic communications briefly went down, and some people even claimed they were seeing double, or that they heard the same voice from multiple directions at once. The incident itself severely disrupted the rescue operation. The Bureau had even suspected that an Esper was the cause, and had already prepared to send in ETD for investigation. But then, all of a sudden, Linko stepped out of the Anomalous Realm on her own. The instant she heard her mother calling out to her, she froze, and the noise disturbing everyone else stopped immediately. The Bureau members on site glanced at one another.
"The trapped citizen is safe and rescued. Victim is a suspected Esper. As for the target Anomaly… Nullification confirmed."

Content.SourceString:
最初，灵可很渴望拥有「朋友」。
清晨的鸽群，午夜的流星，河边的水鸟，沙滩的贝壳，妈妈发现的有趣小店，爸爸推荐的游戏新作——还有那形形色色、从无穷的世界连接向她的小小脑袋的电波……所有的一切，灵可都想讲给自己的朋友听。
但是，她总是孤身一人。或许是因为父母的缘故，灵可比同龄人有着更强的包容与好奇心，不论是异象、昆虫，还是灵异故事、都市传说，灵可都充满好奇。觉醒异能之后，因为电波的存在，她对事物的看法变得更加异于常人。也正是因此，她很难交到朋友，就算是参加学校的集体活动，她也只是安静地呆在角落。
「大家都有自己的频道，如果我主动去与同频的话……是不是就能做朋友了呢？」
觉醒异能之后，灵可可以接收和辨认他人的电波。如果花些时间，与对方同频的话，她还能感受到别人的情绪……这样的话，只要时刻关注对方的情绪，自己应该可以慢慢找到让对方满意的做法。灵可这样想道。
于是，孤单的少女开始试着接近同龄的孩子们，虽然有些生硬和笨拙，但也初见成效。终于，虽然只是孩子堆里最安静的小跟班，她终于找到了自己想要的「朋友」。
至少，在分歧到来之前，她都是这么认为的。
Content.LocalizedString:
At first, Linko desperately sought friends.
The flocks of pigeons at dawn, the comets at midnight, the ducks by the river, the shells on the beach, the interesting little shop her mother found, the new game her father recommended—and all those countless frequencies from the infinite beyond reaching into her little head… Linko wished to speak about it to a true friend.
Despite this, she was always alone. Maybe because of her parents, Linko was more tolerant and curious than other kids her age. Whether it was Anomalies, insects, ghost stories, or urban legends, Linko was always full of curiosity. After her Esper Ability awakened, her ability to sense frequencies made the way she perceived the world around her unlike anyone else. Because of that, she had a very difficult time making friends. Even when she joined after-school group activities, she would just stand quietly in the corner.
"Everyone has their own channel. If I try tuning in to their frequency first… could I become friends with them?"
After her Esper Ability awakened, Linko could receive and discern other people's frequencies. If she spent some time tuning to the same frequency as someone else, she could even begin to experience that person's emotions… Were such a thing to come to pass, as long as she kept paying attention to how they felt, she should slowly but surely figure out what would make them happy. At least, that's what Linko thought.
So, the lonely girl began trying to approach other children her age. She was a little stiff and awkward, but it eventually started to work. At last, though she was merely the quietest little tagalong in the bunch, she had finally found the "friends" she had always wanted.
Anyhow, that was what she believed before the split.

Content.SourceString:
人与异象是无法互相理解的。或者说，一个人无法真正理解一个异象的感受。
一群百无聊赖的孩子在草地上遇见了落单的「棉绒绒」，为首的孩子突发奇想，想要看它变身之后的样子，其他人也纷纷附和，像是对待玩具一般，从逗弄渐渐变成了欺凌。人与异象之间存在着隔阂，幼年人类无法同情一个异象是很自然的事。但灵可只是沉默着，不知道如何开口，她渐渐感受到了棉绒绒的电波，从起初的委屈和困惑，正转变成愤怒。
「停……停下来吧！它现在……很难过，而且这样下去，会有危险……」
灵可第一次大声地、对着「朋友」们说了出来。
可是接下来，不论是感受到的电波，还是听到的声音，都无比冷漠。
「一个异象而已，装什么大好人……」
「你那么在乎它怎么想，就不在乎我们怎么想吗？」
「扫兴的怪胎……」
相比于委屈，灵可心中更多的是失落，她和棉绒绒留在那个草地里，沉默了很久。
被常识或偏见包裹的人们，真的理解彼此吗？又真的能理解彼此吗？也许，「合群」本身只是一种假象，被常识或偏见包裹的人们并不能真正的同频，那些追求合群的努力，最终也只会走向徒劳的僵局。
「我们都活在独属于自己的频段，向宇宙发送着不被回应的电波。」
那天夜里，灵可在日记本里写道。
人与人也是无法互相理解的。或者说，一个人无法真正理解另一个人的感受。
就像那夜空中的星星，海洋中的孤岛，彼此遥望，隔着真空……
灵可不再想交朋友了。
Content.LocalizedString:
Humans and Anomalies can't ever truly understand each other's feelings. Or rather, a human can never really understand an Anomaly.
A group of bored children came across a lone Fluffy in the grass. The kid leading the group got a bright idea: he wanted to see what the Fluffy looked like after it transformed, and the others quickly agreed. Treating it like a toy, their poking and teasing gradually transformed into bullying. There is a natural divide between humans and Anomalies; therefore, it is only natural for children not to empathize with an Anomaly. But Linko stood there in silence, unsure how to speak up. Little by little, she began to pick up Fluffy's frequency as it shifted from hurt and confusion into anger.
"St… stop! It's… really sad right now, and if you guys keep going… it'll be dangerous…"
For the first time in her life, Linko shouted at her "friends."
But what came next, whether it was the frequency she felt or the voices she heard, crushed her hopes.
"It's just an Anomaly. Why are you trying so hard to play the saint…?"
"You care so much about what it feels like, but you don't care about how we feel?"
"What a buzzkill freak…"
More than hurt, what filled Linko's heart was disappointment. She and the Fluffy stayed in that grassy field, silent for a long, long time.
Do people boxed in by common sense or prejudice really understand each other? Can they even understand each other at all? Maybe "fitting in" itself is just an illusion; people imprisoned by judgment can never truly understand one another, and all efforts to fit in will only end in a futile tug-of-war.
"We all live in our own frequencies, sending signals into the universe that go unanswered."
That night, Linko wrote in her diary.
Humans can't understand each other either. One person can never really understand how another feels.
Like stars in the night sky, like islands in the sea, gazing at one another across an abyss…
Linko no longer wanted friends.

Content.SourceString:
十岁那年，灵可时常跟着电波，独自在城市里到处乱走。在途中感受未知的电波，循着电波的方向探索，成了她一人独享的快乐冒险时光——尽管冒险的结果往往只是些稀奇古怪的小物件，偶尔还会引她见到危险的异象，但灵可仍然乐此不疲。
十岁的一个午后，灵可感受到一种温暖的电波，充满着令人动容的生命力。灵可循着方向找去，她穿过街巷，转了好几个弯，最终跟着电波的指引爬上一棵大树。
只是小小的她与大大的树干实在相差太大，爬到一半灵可便没了力气，进退维谷，只能缩在原地思考。突然从更高的树梢上跳下来一个穿着克莱门学园制服的少女，一边说着「你怎么敢一个人爬这么高的树」，一边把她接了下去。
「看！我在玩獭麻吉GO，本来以为树上能抓到稀有的獭麻吉，结果……只抓到了你！给你看我的收藏图鉴……」
「诶？！怎么真的有稀有獭麻吉！你一定是找獭麻吉的天才向导！」
温暖而善良的电波从对面传来，如同被太阳晒热的向日葵一般。灵可也高兴了起来。
此后，灵可经常跟着姐姐在城市里到处探险，也开始收集自己的獭麻吉图鉴，她总是全凭直觉寻找獭麻吉，尽管也惹出过不少麻烦，但寻宠之路仍然是乐趣更多。只是，她的图鉴一直都赶不上姐姐。
过了两年，姐姐忙于学业，把心爱的游戏机和手写的攻略笔记都交给了灵可，请灵可继承她的獭麻吉图鉴，带着她的那一份成为獭麻吉大师。
「灵可就是全海特洛最棒的向导，要相信自己，你的方向是对的！」
最后一次见面时，姐姐这样告诉灵可。
后来灵可继续在城市里探险，继续钻到各个犄角旮旯抓獭麻吉，她仍然常常迷路，但最终都会找到方向。每次抓到新的獭麻吉，她都把自己的图鉴和姐姐的图鉴做比对，却发现这些姐姐都已经收藏过了。但灵可并不灰心，她只是继续寻找，相信总有一天自己的图鉴可以覆盖姐姐、超越姐姐。
只是后来每一次抓到獭麻吉的时候，灵可都再也没有感受到那种温暖而充满生机的电波了。
「原来电波的来源是姐姐啊……」灵可后知后觉地想到。
Content.LocalizedString:
When Linko was ten, she would often follow frequencies and wander all over the city by herself. Feeling out unknown frequencies and exploring wherever they led became her own private, joyful way of passing the time—even if her adventures usually only turned up strange little things, and sometimes even led her to dangerous Anomalies, Linko never got tired of it.
One afternoon, Linko sensed a warm, welcoming frequency, full of an energetic, life-filled energy. She followed its direction, passing through streets and alleys, turning several corners, and even climbing a big tree, all under the frequency's guidance.
She was small, however, and the trunk was huge. She ran out of strength halfway up the tree. Stuck there with nowhere to go, she could only curl up and think of a way out of her situation. Suddenly, a girl in a Clement Academy uniform jumped down from a higher branch and helped her down, all while saying things like, "What were you thinking, climbing a tree this high all by yourself?"
"I'm playing Tamachi GO. I thought I could catch a Rare Tamachi up in the tree, but instead… I only caught you! Here, let me show you my Tamachi Index…"
"Huh?! That really is a Rare Tamachi! You must be a genius at this sort of thing!"
A gentle, kind frequency came from the girl. Like a sunflower basking in the sun. Linko brightened up too.
After that, Linko often went exploring all over the city with her newfound sister-figure, and she started collecting her own Tamachi Index too. She always searched for Tamachi purely by instinct. Even though it got her into plenty of trouble from time to time, the joy of pet-hunting outweighed it all. Still, her Index never quite caught up to her sister's.
Two years later, her sister became busy with school and handed her beloved console and handwritten strategy notes over to Linko, asking her to inherit her Tamachi Index and become a Tamachi Master for the both of them.
"Linko is the best guide in all of Hethereau. Believe in yourself—your path is the right path!"
That was what Linko's sister had said to her the last time they met.
After that, Linko kept exploring the city, squeezing into every nook and cranny to catch Tamachi. She still got lost often, but in the end, she always found her way back home. Every time she caught a new Tamachi, she compared her own Index with her sister's, only to find that her sister had already collected it. Nevertheless, Linko didn't lose heart. She just kept searching, believing that one day her Index would catch up to her sister's and even surpass it.
But from then on, every time she caught a Tamachi, Linko never again felt that same warm, lively frequency.
"So the source of that frequency was my sister all along…"

Content.SourceString:
升入中学后，灵可依然经常在海特洛闲逛，跟随着各种奇妙电波的指引。一天，她走入了一座大楼的后门，误打误撞地闯进了异象空间。那是一个墙壁全是旧电视机的房间，大多数屏幕都已破损，无法亮起。她循着一个温暖而微弱的电波找去，在一堆破烂的旧电视里，她找到了一台很小很小的电视机。
在直觉的驱使下，灵可按下开关，雪花屏闪烁后，一只小幽灵忽然蹦了出来。
「哇！！倒霉的小鬼，竟敢打扰本恶灵休息！作为赔偿，从今天开始，你就是本恶灵的仆人！桀桀桀唔——」
饱览恐怖作品的灵可完全没有被吓到，只是像抓住一只野猫一样，抱起了那只小幽灵。
「原来你没有事，刚刚，你的电波都快要消失了。」
「哈？电波？消失？什么乱七八糟的！我就是在电视里小睡一会儿而已！」
「住在电视里……獭麻吉也是住在屏幕里的，这么说，你和獭麻吉差不多——噢！所以你也是电子宠物！」
「哈？什么鬼东西？你刚刚说谁是宠物！？信不信本恶灵唔唔唔——」
「嗯，以后我就叫你小贞了。」
在令人费解的交涉之后，灵可带走了幽灵小贞……和她的电视机。
而在她们离开异象空间时，一群穿着异象管理局制服的人正在门口严阵以待。
灵可不知道的是，这位小贞曾是一直存在在办公大楼中的异象，她可以钻进各种电视机里，偶尔会突然冒出来，吓一吓加班的上班族们。而这一天，一位异能者罪犯闯入大楼，意欲行凶，当他即将袭击一位无辜的职员时，他们突然被卷入了异象空间之中。根据亲历者的描述，那是一个由无数台电视堆积组成的迷宫，他们被隔绝在安全的房间，而罪犯面对的，是无数屏幕中冒出的鬼火，和它们汇聚而成的一个庞大幽灵。异象空间之中的战斗持续了许久，幽灵的力量几乎耗尽，在几乎被泯除的时刻，她用剩下力量将罪犯弹出了异象空间，随后找到了最后一台完好的电视，陷入休眠……直到灵可将她再次唤醒。
最终，E.T.D六队在空无一人的大楼中逮捕了负伤的异能者罪犯，不久后，灵可和上班族们出现在大楼之中，没有人员伤亡。灵可和小贞受到异象管理局的调查。灵可见到了一个面色阴沉的青年，那些穿制服的人似乎对他相当敬畏。
「塞拉伊诺馆对那个幽灵感兴趣。」
灵可不了解那是什么地方，但直觉告诉她，那对小贞而言不是什么好事。她能隐约感觉到，即使是在面前这个人宛若一潭死水的电波中，或许也会有某处容易松动的突破口……
「小贞她不是坏幽灵，我不会把她交给你们，因为……」
灵可坚定地，将装有小贞的那台电视机紧紧抱在胸前。
「——她是我的朋友，我不想和她分开。」
「……」
青年并没有多说什么。不久后，灵可收到了一份文件。一位禁制机动队的队长为她争取到了保留小贞的结果，以接受E.T.D的管理和安排为条件，她将获准成为小贞的担保人。
「小贞小贞！我现在是你的正式担保人了噢！」
「担保人？那是什么意思？」
「不是主人也不是仆人……嗯……不管啦，总之，你可以留在我身边啦！」
「……嘁嘁嘁~那本恶灵就大发慈悲地照顾一下你吧，电波小鬼！」
Content.LocalizedString:
After starting middle school, Linko still often strolled around Hethereau, following the guidance of all kinds of strange frequencies. One day, she went in through the back door of a building and accidentally stumbled into an Anomalous Realm. It was a room with walls that were lined with old TVs, most of them with broken screens that no longer turned on. Following a faint but warm frequency, she searched through the pile of battered old TVs and found one that was very, very small.
Driven by a sudden instinct, Linko pressed the power switch. After a burst of static, a little ghost suddenly popped out.
"Wah!! You unlucky little imp, how dare you disturb this evil spirit's rest! As compensation, starting today, you belong to this evil spirit as its servant! Heh heh heh—mmph—"
Having seen plenty of horror movies, Linko wasn't scared in the slightest. She simply scooped up the little ghost like she was catching a stray cat on any normal day.
"So you were fine, after all. Just a minute ago, your frequency almost disappeared."
"Huh? Frequency? Gone? What kind of nonsense are you spewing? I was just taking a little nap in the TV!"
"You live in a TV… Tamachi live in a screen too, so you're basically like a Tamachi—oh! So you're an electronic pet!"
"Huh? What the hell is that supposed to mean? Who are you calling a pet!? Believe it or not, this evil spirit will mmmph—"
"Yes. From now on, I'll call you Xiaozhen."
After that baffling negotiation, Linko took the little ghost Xiaozhen away… along with her TV.
But when they left the Anomalous Realm, a group of people in Bureau uniforms were already waiting at the entrance for them.
What Linko didn't know at the time was that Xiaozhen had long existed as an Anomaly inside the office building. She could slip into all kinds of TVs and would occasionally pop out to scare employees working late. But on that day, an Esper criminal broke into the building with hopes to cause harm. Just as he was about to attack an innocent employee, they were suddenly dragged into the Anomalous Realm. According to the people who experienced it firsthand, it was a labyrinth made from countless piled-up TVs. They were sealed away in a safe room, while the criminal was confronted by ghostly fire spilling out from countless TV screens, and by a massive ghost formed from those coalescing flames. The battle in the Anomalous Realm lasted for what felt like hours. The ghost's strength was nearly exhausted, and was almost nullified. However, Xiaozhen used the last of her strength to fling the criminal out of the Anomalous Realm. After that, she found the last intact TV and went into a deep slumber… until Linko suddenly woke her again.
In the end, ETD-6 arrested the injured Esper criminal in the empty building. Not long afterward, Linko and the office workers reappeared inside. Fortunately, there were no casualties. Linko and Xiaozhen were investigated by the Bureau following the whole debacle. Linko met a grim-faced young man, and the uniformed personnel seemed to treat him with considerable deference.
"The Celaeno Compound is interested in that ghost."
Linko didn't know what kind of place that was, but her instincts told her it couldn't mean anything good for Xiaozhen. She could vaguely sense that even within the deathly-still frequency of the man before her, there might be a weak point she could utilize…
"Xiaozhen isn't a malicious spirit. I'm not handing her over to you, because…"
Firm and unflinching, Linko clutched the TV with Xiaozhen inside tightly to her chest.
"—she's my friend. I don't want to be separated from her."
"…"
The young man said nothing more. Not long after, Linko received a document. An ETD captain secured the decision that allowed her to keep Xiaozhen. On the condition that she accept ETD oversight and arrangements, she would be permitted to become Xiaozhen's Guarantor.
"Xiaozhen, Xiaozhen! I'm your official Guarantor now!"
"Guarantor? What does that mean?"
"It's not a master and not a servant… um… whatever. The point is, you get to stay with me!"
"…Heh heh heh~ Then this evil spirit shall graciously look after you, little frequency imp!"

Content.SourceString: 哔啵哔啵——呼叫鉴定师，这里是E.T.D六队的灵可，正在执行「找你出去玩」的任务，收到请回复……或者点点头也可以。
Content.LocalizedString: Beep-boop, beep-boop—Calling the Appraiser, this is Linko from ETD-6, currently working on operation "Let's Hang Out." Please respond… or give me a nod.

Content.SourceString: 接下来要巡逻的区域是……嗯……还是跟着感觉走好了。
Content.LocalizedString: The next section to patrol is… Umm… I'll just go with the flow.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师，浮冰影院好像上映了新的灵异电影，要一起去看看吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser! There's a new paranormal movie at Floe Cinema! Wanna see it together?

Content.SourceString: 海特洛是一座很包容的城市，我巡逻时经常会遇到稀奇有趣的事情，市民们也都见怪不怪的。
Content.LocalizedString: Hethereau is a pretty accepting city. I run into all kinds of fun stuff on my patrols, and the citizens are used to strange things happening from time to time.

Content.SourceString: 听说，如果阳光在脸上晒久了，会有一种暖呼呼、毛茸茸的触感，就像是猫尾巴从脸上扫过去一样……
Content.LocalizedString: They say that if you let the sun shine on your face, you'll get this warm and fuzzy feeling, like a cat whisking its tail on your face…

Content.SourceString: 我很喜欢雨落在空易拉罐上的声音……如果把几个音调不同的易拉罐放在一起，会不会演奏出一首歌呢？
Content.LocalizedString: I really love the sound of rain falling on empty soda cans… if I lined up a few cans with different pitches, could I compose a song?

Content.SourceString:
好冷……要是小贞的鬼火可以用来取暖就好了……
（小贞：哈？怎么可能？你想把我变成热死鬼吗？）
Content.LocalizedString:
So cold… If only Xiaozhen's ghost fire could warm me up…
(Xiaozhen：Huh? How can I do that? I'm not some scorching spirit!)

Content.SourceString:
好热……要是把小贞缠在脖子上，肯定会很凉快……小贞……
（小贞：你想得美！这么热的天，鬼才会从电视里出来！）
Content.LocalizedString:
It's so warm… If I wrapped Xiaozhen around my neck, I'd feel a lot better… Xiao… zhen…
(Xiaozhen：No way! Not even a ghost will leave her TV in this hot weather!)

Content.SourceString:
早上好，鉴定师……唔……昨天睡得有点晚，哈……
（小贞：这小鬼又熬夜，鬼都睡得比你早……）
Content.LocalizedString:
Morning, Appraiser… Oof… I went to bed late last night, hah…
(Xiaozhen: The little scamp stayed up late again. Even ghosts go to bed earlier…)

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师，你说，午睡时做的梦，和晚上做的梦，会有什么不同吗？有没有可能，梦境也和电影院一样，分午间和深夜场？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser, are dreams from naps different from the ones you have at night? Do dreams work like movies in theaters, with matinee showings and late-night showings?

Content.SourceString: 太阳落山了，再过一会儿，这座城市的电波就会慢慢安静下来，就像海水退潮时，那些沙沙的白色浪花一样。
Content.LocalizedString: The sun's setting. Soon, the city's many signals will slowly quiet down, just like the white foam of the waves hissing away as the tide returns to the sea.

Content.SourceString: 宇宙每晚都会唱摇篮曲，有时是星星，有时是月亮……要是鉴定师也能听见就好了。
Content.LocalizedString: The universe sings a lullaby every night, sometimes it's the stars, sometimes it's the moon… Appraiser, if only you could hear it too.

Content.SourceString:
我家里有一个装满了电影碟片的大柜子，每天晚上，我都会随机抽一张出来，和小贞一起看。我喜欢外星人和灵异题材的电影，但小贞很嫌弃。她说，与其看那些用特效虚构的东西，还不如看她这个货真价实的恶灵……
（小贞：哼！本恶灵要是当电影主角，绝对比它们吓人一千倍！）
Content.LocalizedString:
I got this big cabinet at home stuffed with movie discs. Each night, I pick one randomly and watch it with Xiaozhen. I love alien and paranormal stuff, but Xiaozhen hates them. She always says why bother watching fake special effects when she, an actual spirit, is the real deal…
(Xiaozhen: Hmph! If they ever cast this evil spirit as the antagonist, I'll make a movie that's a thousand times scarier!)

Content.SourceString: 烦恼……我没有想过。一定要说的话，应该是一些还没找到答案的问题吧。比如……异色的獭麻吉该去哪抓，Exe为什么总对曳尔沐姐姐生气，该怎么让小贞承认自己很可爱，宇宙深处的电波是什么样的……还有，频道各不相同的大家，真的能做到理解彼此吗……好多好多的问题，我都不明白。
Content.LocalizedString: Worries… I've never thought about any. If I must say, I guess I don't have the answers to certain questions. Like… where to catch a shiny Tamachi, why Exe is always mad at Elyms, how to get Xiaozhen to admit she's cute, what the radio waves from deep space actually sound like… and, whether people tuned to different frequencies can really understand each other… so many questions, so few answers.

Content.SourceString: 世界像一个电台，人类、异象、还有其它的万物，都在独属于自己的频道里，释放着独一无二的电波。每次接收到有趣的电波，我都会去寻找它的来源……通常，越是奇特的电波，它的来源就越令人意外，比如在河边一动不动、沉思人生的哲学家水鸟，在麦田里顶着铁锅、呼唤外星人的市民，还有讨厌孤单、希望有人上门做客的地点异象，之类的。
Content.LocalizedString: The world is like a radio station. Humans, anomalies, and everything else all broadcast their unique signal on their private channels. Whenever I pick up an interesting signal, I go look for where it came from… Usually, the stranger the signal, the more surprising its source turns out to be: like a philosophical water bird standing by the river, contemplating life; or some local resident standing in a wheat field with a pot on their head, trying to summon aliens; or a location anomaly that hates being alone and craves visitors.

Content.SourceString:
这个耳机是异象管理局为我定制的，好像叫什么……「滤波监听耳机」？我只要扭动这个旋钮，就可以清除噪波的干扰，让我能集中精神、搜索特定的电波频段，就像给收音机调频一样。它也可以当作正常耳机用，我用它听过异象自创的摇滚乐、歧骸叫声合集、异象空间白噪音之类的，音质非常好。
（小贞：听的都是什么鬼东西……）
Content.LocalizedString:
The Bureau gave me this customized headset. I think it's called… the "Static Sifter Headset"? I turn this dial, and it clears out the noise, letting me focus and search for a specific frequency, kind of like a radio. It also doubles as regular headphones. I use it to listen to rock music from anomalies, compilations of oddity calls, or white noise from anomalous realms… stuff like that. The sound quality's great.
(Xiaozhen：What in Hethereau do you listen to…)

Content.SourceString: 獭麻吉GO是一款电子宠物游戏，以前非常火爆，很多玩家会跑到大街上捉宠和对战，但现在已经没什么人玩了……哼哼，其实现在站在你面前的，就是海特洛排名前五的獭麻吉高手——距离图鉴全收集就差一步……嗯，算上异色和隐藏款的话，大概……三四步之遥！
Content.LocalizedString: Tamachi GO is a game about electronic pets. It used to be insanely popular. Tons of players flooded the streets to catch pets and battle. Not a lot of people play it these days… Heheh, In fact, before you stands one of Hethereau's top five Tamachi masters—just one step away from catching them all—well, counting shiny ones and variants, more like—three or four steps away!

Content.SourceString: 我可以感受到周围人的「电波」，如果集中精神、倾听其中的一个，会有一种逐渐清晰的共鸣感，直到某一刻，那个感受突然变得完整、通透，像是节奏完全相同的心跳，将我和电波的来源连在一起——理解一切，分享一切，不再有任何误解和阻碍……我很向往那种感觉，哪怕只有一瞬间。
Content.LocalizedString: I can sense the frequencies of the people around me. If I focus and listen closely to one of them, there's this resonance that gradually sharpens, until at some point, everything feels transparent and encompassing, like a heartbeat perfectly in sync, linking me straight to the source of that signal, understanding everything, sharing everything—no more misunderstandings or barriers in the way… I long for that feeling, even just for a fleeting moment.

Content.SourceString:
我和小贞一起战斗的样子，应该没吓到你吧？那双大手其实是小贞的，至于是怎么做到的……如果我和某个电波足够合拍，有时就可以和它的来源完全「共鸣」……就像一种情绪、感受、力量……甚至身体的指挥权都能共享的……变强的状态？但它很难持续，现在，我能够稳定维持「共鸣」的对象，也只有小贞一个……
（小贞：哈？有我还不够吗？去问问你抓的那些坏蛋，哪个不是对本恶灵的大手闻风丧胆！你个臭小鬼还嫌弃上了，哼……）
Content.LocalizedString:
I hope the way Xiaozhen and I fight alongside each other doesn't scare you. Those big hands are actually Xiaozhen's. As for how we make it work… if I'm synced enough with a certain frequency, sometimes I can fully resonate with its source… It's like we share emotions, feelings, powers, and act as one… It feels like some kind of power-up state? It's hard to keep that going though. Right now, Xiaozhen's the only one I can keep a stable resonance with…
(Xiaozhen：Huh? Am I not enough for you? Why don't you go ask those baddies you arrested about how I scared the heck outta them! Can't believe this scamp wants more, humph…)

Content.SourceString: 我的爸爸和妈妈都是异能者。爸爸的异能是可以陷在沙发里一整天、一声不吭连着看好多部电影，妈妈的异能是可以一边不停聊天、一边逛完十几条街不休息。我继承了他们俩的异能，但可能是因为他们的属性完全相反，我只继承到了削弱后的版本。和他们相比，我只是普通的喜欢看电影和到处玩而已……
Content.LocalizedString: Both my mom and dad are Espers. Dad's power is sinking into the couch for a whole day and binging through movies quietly. Mom's power is talking nonstop while walking through a dozen streets without needing rest. I inherited both of their powers, but maybe because they are total opposites, I just got a watered-down power. Compared to them, I just have an ordinary love for movies and going out for fun…

Content.SourceString: 六队的职责……简单来说，就是抓住那些用异象或异能做坏事的家伙。我的日常工作，就是借助异能搜寻和追踪他们。通常Exe会给我分享一些目标的情报，比如出没地点、用过的身份、或者刷过什么网站、爱听什么音乐之类的，我了解过后，就大概能知道对方的电波是什么样子，然后就可以在城市里边听边找来源了……什么原理？嗯……我不知道，总之就是……凭感觉？
Content.LocalizedString: Unit-6's job… simply put, is catching people who use anomalies or their Esper Ability to do bad things. My day-to-day is using my powers to search for baddies and track them down. Usually, Exe shares with me intel about a target, like where they've been spotted, aliases they've used, or what websites they've browsed, and what kind of music they like, stuff like that. Once I get a feel, I can figure out what their frequencies sounds like, then I just go around the city listening for where they're coming from… How does it actually work? Um… I don't know, it's basically just… going with the vibe?

Content.SourceString:
妮夏的电波很规则，就像是……节拍固定、一板一眼的钢琴曲，有时还会越弹越快，听着让人喘不过气来。但她超级可靠！E.T.D工作手册里的流程规范，妮夏能一字不差地背出来，但……她也总是想照着流程、一字不差地完美执行，如果遇到意外的状况，她就会把自己绷得紧紧的。不过不用担心，作为前辈，我会好好照顾妮夏的！
（小贞：明明你就比人家早来半年……）
Content.LocalizedString:
Nitsa's frequency is super regular, like… a piano that follows the music sheet's every detail. Sometimes it speeds up, until it's hard to catch your breath even if you just listen. But she's extremely reliable! She can recite the entire ETD standard procedure manual word for word. The problem is… she always wants to follow the process step by step and do everything by the book. When she runs into something unexpected, she tends to freak out. But don't you worry, as Nitsa's senpai, I'll take care of her!
(Xiaozhen: You know, you started like half a year ahead of her…)

Content.SourceString:
卡厄斯的电波很吵，和他本人一样，总是絮絮叨叨的。只有在面对异能者坏蛋的时候，他的频道会静下来，变成一阵一阵的、像是野兽低吼的声音……我们虽然经常一起出任务，但大多数时候都是分头行动，因为他总是会在跟踪目标时和我走散……嗯，当然是他走丢了，我选的路才是对的。
（小贞：我要是卡厄斯，我现在就把你的呆毛拔下来。）
Content.LocalizedString:
Frequency from Chaos tends to be noisy—it goes on and on, just like his chatters. His channel only goes quiet when he faces Esper criminals. In those times, his signal rumbles and growls, almost like some wild beast… Though we team up for many missions, we often end up splitting up because he wanders off while tailing a target… I mean, obviously he's the one who gets lost when I'm the one on the right path.
(Xiaozhen: If I were Chaos, I'd grab your ahoge and pull it off right now.)

Content.SourceString: 曳尔沐姐姐……能和她再次相见，我真的很开心。但她的电波和过去完全不一样，像是好多个不稳定的频道叠在了一起，我很难听清楚……第一次见面的时候，我还以为我认错了，但她一眼就认出了我，也记得带我捉獭麻吉的事，甚至还和当年一样，总喜欢捏我的脸……可能人的电波也是会变的吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Big sis Elyms… I'm so happy to see her again. Her frequencies are completely different from before. They're now like a bunch of unstable channels stacked on top of each other. It's hard for me to hear clearly… When we met again, I thought she was someone else, but she recognized me right away. She even remembered taking me to catch Tamachis. She still likes to pinch my cheeks, just like back then… I guess people's frequencies can change too.

Content.SourceString: Exe喜欢把自己关在机房里，平时很难见到他，偶尔露面时也总是板着个脸，看上去凶凶的，但他其实是个很温和的人。他的电波很催眠，像是隔着厚窗户听到的雨声……或者是那种均匀的、噼哩啪啦敲键盘的声音。但有的时候……准确的说，主要是他和曳尔沐姐姐在一起的时候，他的频道里会突然翻涌起一些很可怕的、我不敢仔细听的声音……要是他们能好好相处就好了。
Content.LocalizedString: Exe likes to shut himself away in the server room. It's pretty hard to see him in person. When he does show up, he always has this stern and intimidating look, but he's actually a gentle person. His frequency is almost hypnotic, like listening to rain through a thick window… or that steady, rapid clatter of someone typing on the keyboard. But sometimes… well, mostly when he's around big sis Elyms, I hear these scary noises from him and they scare me a bit… Anyway, I hope they get along some day.

Content.SourceString: 我第一次见到小贞，是在一个异象空间的深处。当时，我接收到一个……像刚关掉的显像管电视屏幕一样的，有些温暖、但又毛刺刺的电波。我一边收听，一边搜寻它的来源，最后发现了一台旧电视机。接通电源后，小贞就出现在了屏幕里，像睡在烂纸箱里的野猫一样……没错，就是我背后这台小电视，它现在是小贞的家，而我是背着她的家到处走的人，简称家人。
Content.LocalizedString: The first time I met Xiaozhen was deep inside an anomalous realm. Back then, I picked up a frequency that felt like… a CRT TV screen that was just switched off—warm but with some static. I listened as I searched for the source, then I found an old TV. Once I plugged it in, Xiaozhen appeared on the screen, curled up like a stray cat sleeping in a tattered cardboard box… Yep, it's the little TV I carry on my back, that's her home, and I'm the one who carries her home around. That makes me her family.

Content.SourceString: 你想知道我们的事？我想想……其实，Exe是会笑的。我和他聊到一些老游戏的时候，他偶尔会露出怀念的笑容，但马上又会消沉下去……曳尔沐姐姐很温柔，但有时，我会听到她会对Exe说一些难懂的话，希望她不是在欺负队长……卡厄斯嘴上总说小罗只是他用异能捏的假狗，但其实对它特别好……至于我的话，嗯……哦对，其实，我是外星人。
Content.LocalizedString: You want to know more about us? Let me think… Actually, Exe does smile. Sometimes when we talk about old games, he gets this nostalgic smile, but then he sinks right back into gloom… Big sis Elyms is very kind, but sometimes I catch her telling Exe things too difficult for me to understand. I really hope she's not bullying the captain… As for Chaos, he always says Dally is nothing but a construct he created with his power, but honestly, he treats the hound really well… As for me, umm… Oh right, I'm actually an alien.

Content.SourceString: 噢，这种感觉……还是第一次。
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, this feeling… That's a first.

Content.SourceString:
哦？！灵可的样子……发生了一些变化！
（小贞：从呆瓜变成了大呆瓜。）
Content.LocalizedString:
What? Linko is… evolving!
(Xiaozhen：She's evolving! Just backwards.)

Content.SourceString:
灵可最终进化——唔， 进化成什么呢……究极灵可！
（小贞：你还真是玩不腻啊……）
Content.LocalizedString:
Linko's final evolution—umm, what should I evolve into… Ultimate Linko!
(Xiaozhen：You never get bored…)

Content.SourceString: 唔噢——鉴定师怎么知道我想要这个？难道……鉴定师能感受到我的电波？
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, wow! Appraiser, how did you know I wanted this? Does that mean… you're receiving my frequency?

Content.SourceString: 我很喜欢这个，谢谢鉴定师……我们的电波果然是同频的。
Content.LocalizedString: I like this a lot. Thank you, Appraiser… I knew we were in sync.

Content.SourceString:
感谢大自然的馈赠——
（小贞：oi，明明是鉴定师送你的，关大自然什么事。）
Content.LocalizedString:
Oh, the unlimited bounties of nature!
(Xiaozhen: Oi, that's from the Appraiser, not from mother nature.)

Content.SourceString: 我会珍藏的，谢谢你，鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll treasure this. Thank you, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 下面有请！
Content.LocalizedString: Please welcome…!

Content.SourceString: 一起揍它！
Content.LocalizedString: Let's beat 'em together!

Content.SourceString: 同频准备！
Content.LocalizedString: Ready to sync!

Content.SourceString: 电波连接着我们每一个人！
Content.LocalizedString: We're all connected by frequencies!

Content.SourceString: 同频率提升至……100%！
Content.LocalizedString: Sync rate reaching… 100%!

Content.SourceString: 共鸣领域……展开！
Content.LocalizedString: Resonance domain… expanding!

Content.SourceString: （小贞：还没完呢！）
Content.LocalizedString: (Xiaozhen: It's not over yet!)

Content.SourceString: （小贞：该我们啦！）
Content.LocalizedString: (Xiaozhen: It's our turn!)

Content.SourceString: （小贞：嘻嘻嘻嘻~）
Content.LocalizedString: (Xiaozhen: Teeheeheehee!)

Content.SourceString: 咦……好像冷场了……
Content.LocalizedString: Umm… this is awkward…

Content.SourceString: （小贞：喂——队友们都去哪啦？）
Content.LocalizedString: (Xiaozhen: Team—? Where did you go?)

Content.SourceString: 是我口号喊得不对吗？那……异能者——集结！好像也不行……
Content.LocalizedString: Did I say the wrong catchphrase? Then… Espers—Assemble! (*More silence*) That's not working either…

Content.SourceString: 抓完异象，该去抓獭麻吉了。
Content.LocalizedString: Anomaly contained. Time to catch Tamachis.

Content.SourceString: 收容图鉴，增加了！
Content.LocalizedString: My containment index is more complete!

Content.SourceString: 它的电波……消失了。
Content.LocalizedString: Its frequency… gone.

Content.SourceString: 任务完成，灵可的经验值上升了！
Content.LocalizedString: Mission accomplished, Linko gets an EXP boost!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师，这有好东西。
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, Appraiser! There's good stuff here.

Content.SourceString: 原来是在这里。
Content.LocalizedString: It's been here all the time.

Content.SourceString: 电波的源头……找到了。
Content.LocalizedString: The source of the signal… found it.

Content.SourceString: 嗯，还好没漏掉。
Content.LocalizedString: Phew. Glad I didn't miss it.

Content.SourceString: 它等我们好久了。
Content.LocalizedString: It's been waiting for us for a while.

Content.SourceString: 哼哼~
Content.LocalizedString: Lalala!

Content.SourceString:
集中……精神……
（小贞：小鬼，不要勉强！）
Content.LocalizedString:
Concen… trate…
(Xiaozhen: Scamp, hang in there!)

Content.SourceString:
（小贞：喂，情况不妙啊。）
还……没结束！
Content.LocalizedString:
(Xiaozhen: Hey, this is bad!)
It's not… over!

Content.SourceString:
（小贞：小鬼，扛不住可别硬扛！）
我……能行！
Content.LocalizedString:
(Xiaozhen: Scamp, don't take any more hits!)
I can… do this!

Content.SourceString: 呼——还能继续。
Content.LocalizedString: Phew—I'll keep going.

Content.SourceString: 嗯，好多了。
Content.LocalizedString: Mm, much better.

Content.SourceString: 小贞……对不……起……
Content.LocalizedString: Xiao… zhen… sorry…

Content.SourceString: 听不……见了……
Content.LocalizedString: I can't… hear…

Content.SourceString: （小贞：喂！小鬼……小鬼！）
Content.LocalizedString: (Xiaozhen: Hey, scamp… scamp!)

Content.SourceString: 呼……搞定。
Content.LocalizedString: Phew… all done.

Content.SourceString: （小贞：见鬼去吧！）
Content.LocalizedString: (Xiaozhen：Join the dead!)

Content.SourceString:
……
（小贞：找它算账！）
Content.LocalizedString:
……
(Xiaozhen：It's payback time!)

Content.SourceString:
没躲开……
（小贞：那就打回去！）
Content.LocalizedString:
I got hit…
(Xiaozhen：Then hit back!)

Content.SourceString:
（小贞：啧、小鬼？！）
我……没事！
Content.LocalizedString:
(Xiaozhen：Tch, scamp!?)
I'm… alright!

Content.SourceString:
呃唔——
（小贞：这个混帐！）
Content.LocalizedString:
Uh… ngh…
(Xiaozhen：You thug!)

Content.SourceString: 哼哼~我就知道你会选我。
Content.LocalizedString: Heheh, I knew you'd choose me.

Content.SourceString: 小贞小贞，该我们上场了！
Content.LocalizedString: Xiaozhen, Xiaozhen, we're up!

Content.SourceString: 吃我一拳！
Content.LocalizedString: Eat this!

Content.SourceString: （小贞：闹鬼时间！）
Content.LocalizedString: (Xiaozhen: It's hauntin' time!)

Content.SourceString: 小贞，就是现在！
Content.LocalizedString: Xiaozhen, now!

Content.SourceString: 重拳出击！
Content.LocalizedString: Heavy punch!

Content.SourceString: （小贞：我在这儿呢！）
Content.LocalizedString: (Xiaozhen: I'm over here!)

Content.SourceString: （小贞：恶灵驾到！）
Content.LocalizedString: (Xiaozhen: BOO!)

Content.SourceString: 飘飘~
Content.LocalizedString: Weee!

Content.SourceString: 要去哪里？
Content.LocalizedString: Destination, where?

Content.SourceString: 指令已接收！
Content.LocalizedString: Orders received.

Content.SourceString: 该我们出手了！
Content.LocalizedString: It's our turn!

Content.SourceString: （小贞：欠揍的家伙都在哪？）
Content.LocalizedString: (Xiaozhen：Who should I beat up?)

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师鉴定师！我们来帮忙！
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, we're here to help!

Content.SourceString: 队长……居然出门了？！
Content.LocalizedString: Captain… went out of his room?

Content.SourceString: 曳尔沐姐姐……连上了！
Content.LocalizedString: Big sis Elyms… synced!

Content.SourceString: 等下班了，能把小罗借我摸摸吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Can I pet Dally when we're off duty?

Content.SourceString:
鉴定师的电波……消失了……
（小贞：小鬼！别走神！）
Content.LocalizedString:
Appraiser's signal… gone…
(Xiaozhen：Scamp! Focus!)

Content.SourceString: 不好，队长的运动量好像透支了……
Content.LocalizedString: Oh no, captain went over his exercise quota…

Content.SourceString: 曳尔沐姐姐？奇怪，她去哪了……
Content.LocalizedString: Big sis Elyms, where did you go…?

Content.SourceString: 不，还没到告别的时候。
Content.LocalizedString: No, it's not time to part ways.

Content.SourceString:
确反康！
（小贞：那是啥意思……）
Content.LocalizedString:
Punish counter!
(Xiaozhen：What kind of game are you playing…)

Content.SourceString: （小贞：想得美！）
Content.LocalizedString: (Xiaozhen：Not so fast!)

Content.SourceString: 同频成功。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm in sync!

Content.SourceString: （小贞：走位可以啊~小鬼！）
Content.LocalizedString: (Xiaozhen: Nice movement, scamp!)
